qLines: Q: Hi Tobi, I'm Q, your analyst here at Capital Q. I'll set up your company profile with you in a quick chat, about 3 minutes, so I can match you with the investors who fit your raise. If you have a pitch deck or anything else, upload it while we talk and I'll read it. To start: What's your website?
